errors.text: The central prediction has the wrong sign: it predicts initial suppression and possible partial recovery, whereas the target reports an approximately 12% conductivity increase with increasing SRO.
The proposed L12/L11 motifs are poorly matched to the target single-phase bcc system, whose relevant mediators are B2-like HfTi/TiZr clusters and percolating pathways.
The mechanism omits the target's dominant effects: reduced lattice distortion and formation of high-conductivity percolation pathways.
The cited evidence does not directly establish the claimed SRO-dependent lattice thermal-conductivity trend or phonon band-gap mechanism in a refractory HEA.
Measurements by TDTR or 3-omega provide total thermal conductivity in a metallic alloy; operation at 50 K does not by itself isolate the lattice contribution.
